# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** school teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

She has lovely fair curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears sleeve puffs that are larger than anyone else's in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic, and disciplined young woman who possesses a natural talent for winning and keeping the affection of her students. She inspires her pupils to put forth their best efforts both morally and mentally. She maintains perfect order in her schoolroom without ever resorting to corporal punishment.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the school trustees as the first female teacher in Avonlea school. She introduced innovations to the school curriculum such as alternate Friday afternoon recitations, field days in the woods to study nature, and morning and evening physical culture exercises. After catching Anne Shirley reading a novel tucked inside her Canadian history desk during school hours, Miss Stacy held her back at recess to gently correct her for wasting time and deceiving her teacher, before freely forgiving her. At the end of her first year, despite rumors that she would take a job offer in her home district's grade school, she returned to Avonlea for another term to prepare her older students for the Entrance examinations. During her tenure, she advised ambitious pupils such as Anne and Gilbert Blythe on taking up Second Year work at Queen's Academy. Her rule at Avonlea school concluded at the end of June following her second year of teaching.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)_
